Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026181124id_/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* Retrieving a specific card can be reduced from 1 card retrieved to 0.
* Code Clearance stacks an Interrupt after it retrieves Force. By this time, the Interrupt could already have been stacked on another grabber (e.g. [[Allegations Of Corruption]]) first, in which case it remains on that first grabber.
* Code Clearance can stack an Interrupt before [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough{{!}}This Place Can Be A Little Rough]] can place it out of play.
* [[Outrider]] places Utinni Effects out of play before Code Clearance can stack.
* DS cards such as [[You Swindled Me!]] may be stacked.

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the type bar) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Cor-D-dotheyhaveacodeclearance-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Do They Have A Code Clearance?]]: Same words as the previous version. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Do They Have A Code Clearance?” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
